props.description: Picked emoji, or null from "remove icon".
props.name: onValueChange

props.description: Offer "remove icon" while a value is set.
props.name: removable

props.description: localStorage key for the per-user recents.
props.name: recentsKey

props.description: Replace the default trigger (e.g. the page icon drawn large).
props.name: trigger

props.description: Accessible name for the trigger; defaults to the localized "Choose an icon".
props.name: aria-label

related: CommandPalette — items can carry an emoji `icon`.
tagline: Page icon / reaction picker in a Popover (gh#1164): search by the active language's CLDR keywords (ja / en / vi — emojibase-data, loaded lazily for that locale only), categories, per-user recents, a WAI-ARIA grid (one tab stop, arrows, Home / End, Enter), and "remove icon". No skin tones.
usage: DO use it for a page icon next to PageContainer `icon` — pass the icon itself as `trigger`.
The data loads on first open (one locale, ~100 KB gzip); nothing ships in your main bundle.
